context.content_translation:
Hunt’s Gift Shop 携带各种-------，包括《Swinnville Daily News》和《West Bay Monthly》。
A. publication
B. publications
C. publish
D. published

items.question: Hunt’s Gift Shop carries a wide selection of -------, including the Swinnville Daily News 119 and West Bay Monthly.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“publications”代入题干后为“Hunt’s Gift Shop carries a wide selection of publications, including the Swinnville Daily News 119 and West Bay Monthly.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（publications）。
